notes: Vpi 4.74 V from a 5 MHz triangular sweep with a 1 GHz photodiode (Fig. 5(a)); the text writes "VpiL at 5 MHz is 4.74 V for our 5 mm long device", read as Vpi (the Fig. 5(a) annotation reads "Vpi=4.74V", which resolves the text label), VpiL 2.37 V cm = 4.74 V x 0.5 cm derived exactly (abstract writes ~2.37; the approximation sign is not carried). Push-pull stated (p.2). 3 dB EO bandwidth over 110 GHz: EO S21 measured 10 MHz to 110 GHz with a roll-off of about 2.5 dB, no 3 dB crossing; reference 10 MHz is the start of the measured trace. Electrode EE S21 roll-off 4.5 dB at 110 GHz and S11 below -15 dB (Fig. 4(d)); the authors use the 6.4 dB EE bandwidth as an estimate of the 3 dB EO bandwidth. Wavelength of Vpi and EO S21 measurements not stated: 1549.93 nm is the ECL line of the transmission experiment (simulation at 1550 nm). Total insertion loss about 18 dB with a lensed fiber, mainly mode mismatch; bending loss non-negligible. ER > 23 dB by DC measurement. Sidewall nearly 90 deg from horizontal with a ~20 deg slope at the bottom of one side (SEM, Fig. 4(b)). Waveguide width 1.3 um with an original mask width slightly larger to compensate lateral wet etching. Transmission: PAM-6 250 Gb/s BER 2.3e-2 and PAM-4 200 Gb/s BER 3.2e-3 (text), below both threshold lines of Fig. 6(b) (20 percent SD-FEC 2.4e-2 and HD-FEC 3.8e-3; the text cites only 2.4e-2); system limited by the 45 GHz AWG and 50 GHz amplifier; 100 Gbaud spectra and eyes in Fig. 6; baud of the 250 Gb/s point not stated. Laser output 17 dBm, signal after the modulator amplified to 1 dBm (EDFA). No supplement.

IL and propagation loss are given once for the MZM on the chip (device not named), entered here. Dynamic ER 7.14 dB (80 Gb/s OOK), 4.42 dB (112 Gb/s OOK), 5.05 and 5.09 dB (PAM-4 40 and 50 GBd). BER: text p.9 says the BERs of 64 Gb/s OOK and 80 Gb/s PAM-4 remain below the KP4 threshold 2.4e-4, but in Fig. 6(f) the 80 Gb/s PAM-4 points lie above 2.4e-4 from -18 to -15 dBm (below 3.8e-3 from about -17 dBm) and reach about 2.4e-4 only near -14 dBm, and the 64 Gb/s OOK points at -23 to -21 dBm also lie above 2.4e-4 (read from the plot). Drive and Vpi convention not stated by the authors: push-pull inferred from one waveguide in each gap of the G-S-G electrode (Fig. 1(a) inset), basis derived. Vpi 3.2 V from a 5 kHz, 8 V peak-to-peak triangle, constant from 50 Hz to 500 kHz (Fig. 3(b)); VpiL 2.4 V cm = 3.2 V x 0.75 cm (stated 2.4 in the abstract and Table 1). bw3db_ghz left empty: self-contradiction (convention y). Text p.6: "the 3-dB BW corresponding to the measured response curve (blue line) exceeds 67 GHz" (also abstract and conclusion), but the measured EO S21 trace of Fig. 4(a) drops below the -3 dB line at about 57 GHz (about -3.2 dB), about 64 GHz (about -3.5 dB, deepest) and again near 66-67 GHz (about -3.3 dB, read from the plot); the authors attribute the strong fluctuation from 45 to 67 GHz to the probing region (about 10 percent of the length). bw_measured_to_ghz 67 (67 GHz photodetector) is the measured range. Stated FoM BW/Vpi^2 = 6.8 GHz/V^2 (Table 1) differs from 67/3.2^2 = 6.5. n_rf 2.2 at 47 GHz (Fig. 2(b)); ng_opt 2.2 is quoted by the authors (p.5, 'group index of the optical mode (ng = 2.2)') without a source. RF loss: text gives alpha0 0.74 dB/cm/GHz^0.5 (6.1 dB/cm at 67 GHz, matching the simulated curve) while the measured curve in Fig. 2(c) reaches about 9 dB/cm at 67 GHz, so no RF loss is entered. Z0 near 50 ohm at low frequency, ripples from 45 GHz (Fig. 2(b)), no single value. Propagation loss about 0.5 dB/cm (caption: less than 0.5) is for the single-mode ring waveguide (microring Lorentz fit), not the 2.2 um arm waveguide, so not entered. Power drift below 1 dB over 60 min at the second quadrature point. Sidewall angle 69 deg stated without its reference, left empty (Fig. 1(a) inset: top 2.2 um, bottom 2.4 um). IL and ER not reported.
